## 3. Synthesized Insights

**The most important hire is not an executor. It is a voice.**

The organization already has execution infrastructure (ATLAS). What it needs is someone who can translate the mission into messages that reach educators before they ever meet Coach G in person.

A generic "marketing agent" would be insufficient. The agent needs to:
- Know the educator deeply (their fears, their hopes, their skepticism)
- Know the brand deeply (Coach G's values, voice, aesthetic, mission)
- Know the framework (SB7 — educator as hero, guide positioning)
- Know the stakes (the equity gap is real; the messaging must honor that)

**The name needed to carry weight.** Not functional. Aspirational. Something that matches the energy of the mission.
